# Step 3 — uv

*Part of the [2 × GH200 host setup guide](README.md).*

---

```bash
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
# lands in ~/.local/bin/uv ; ~/.bashrc already exports PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
exec "$SHELL" -l
uv --version          # source host: uv 0.12.0
```

Pin to 0.12.0 if you want an exact match: `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.12.0/install.sh | sh`.

Reproduced on `lego-c2g2-smc-035` (2026-08-22) with the pinned installer: uv lands in
`~/.local/bin/{uv,uvx}` and `~/.bashrc` already has `$HOME/.local/bin` on `PATH`, so
no shell edit was needed. `uv sync --extra dev` then took **48 s** end to end,
including fetching CPython 3.10.20 and `torch 2.11.0+cu128`.

uv will download CPython 3.10.20 itself (`requires-python = "==3.10.*"`); no system
Python is used. The system Python on noble is 3.12.3 and is **not** what the venv
runs on.
